title: Navimower 0.4.6-beta3

## MQTT / History main-thread performance hotfix

This beta addresses issue #406, where Home Assistant could become effectively unresponsive while the Navimower MQTT location callback rebuilt a large active History trail on the Home Assistant main asyncio thread.

A Python fault-handler trace from the report captured:

```text
MQTT location update
-> coordinator.ingest_mqtt_location()
-> history.active_trail_xy()
-> _card_points()
-> Garbage-collecting
```

### Full legacy trail is removed from the coordinator hot path

Before beta3, every MQTT location update and normal private-cloud refresh materialized the complete active card-facing trail into the coordinator snapshot:

```text
new pose
-> append History sample
-> rebuild all active XY points
-> simplify all points
-> publish coordinator state
```

The cost therefore grew with the active session length and created many temporary Python objects.

Beta3 no longer stores the full legacy trail in normal coordinator state. It keeps only O(1) metadata such as the active raw point count, session revision and start time.

Legacy Map API compatibility is retained: old card consumers can still request the full `trail` / `trail_segments` through the Map API.

### Prepared render startup work no longer captures a large live source on the event loop

Prepared Live source capture may still need legacy/current-session geometry for compatibility, but beta3 moves that source construction into Home Assistant's executor before the prepared render model is built.

This is especially relevant to a direct 0.4.4 -> 0.4.5/0.4.6 upgrade, where a user can already have a large retained History session while the new prepared caches are cold. Beta-line testers may have accumulated the new caches incrementally and therefore never hit the same startup pressure.

### New diagnostics

Download diagnostics now expose:

- active History raw point count without rebuilding the trail;
- card-trail materialization count, last duration and maximum duration;
- coordinator MQTT ingest count, last duration and maximum duration.

These counters make it possible to compare large-property/multi-mower installations with issue #406 without exporting route geometry.

### Compatibility

- No History samples are dropped or capped.
- No mower/task/schedule semantics change.
- Existing Map API legacy fallback remains available.
- Navimower Map Card 0.3.7 remains compatible.
